mapper.select: SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.common.mapper.selectFileUldList */ a.authrt_cd , a.up_authrt_cd , a.task_se_cd , a.authrt_nm , a.authrt_type_cd , a.authrt_expln , a.use_yn , a.wrtr_dept_nm , a.mdfr_dept_nm , a.rgtr_id , a.reg_dt , a.mdfr_id , a.mdfcn_dt FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_exprt_authrt e JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_authrt a ON e.authrt_cd = a.authrt_cd WHERE e.mbr_no = #{mbrNo} AND a.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY reg_dt DESC

SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.common.mapper.selectOneExprtAuthrtByMbrNo */ mbr_no, exprt_task_sn, authrt_cd, rgtr_id, reg_dt, mdfr_id, mdfcn_dt FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_exprt_authrt WHERE mbr_no = #{mbrNo} ORDER BY exprt_task_sn DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.common.mapper.selectEmpInfoByEmpNo */ emp_no AS empNo, emp_nm AS empNm, dept_no AS deptNo, encpt_emp_eml_nm AS encptEmpEmlNm, encpt_emp_telno AS encptEmpTelno, reg_dt AS regDt, mdfr_id AS mdfrId, mdfcn_dt AS mdfcnDt FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_emp_info WHERE emp_no = #{empNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.common.mapper.selectMemberAndInstByMbrId */ m.mbr_no AS mbrNo , m.mbr_id AS mbrId , m.encpt_mbr_flnm AS mbrEncptFlnm , m.encpt_mbr_eml_nm AS mbrEncptEmlNm , m.encpt_mbr_telno AS mbrEncptTelno , m.mbr_type_cd AS mbrTypeCd , m.mbr_join_stts_cd AS mbrJoinSttsCd , m.mbr_join_dt AS mbrJoinDt , i.brno AS instBrno , i.inst_nm AS instNm , i.del_yn AS instDelYn , e.exprt_hdof_yn AS exprtHdofYn , e.aprv_stts_cd AS exprtAprvSttsCd FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_mbr_info m LEFT JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_exprt_info e ON m.mbr_no = e.mbr_no LEFT JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_inst i ON e.brno = i.brno WHERE m.mbr_id = #{mbrId} LIMIT 1

WITH RECURSIVE menu_tree AS ( SELECT m.menu_sn , m.menu_nm , m.up_menu_sn , m.task_se_cd , m.menu_seq , d.menu_url_addr , 1 AS menu_lv FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_menu m LEFT JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_d_menu d ON m.menu_sn = d.menu_sn WHERE m.up_menu_sn IS NULL AND m.task_se_cd = 'CM' AND m.menu_type_cd = 'E' AND m.use_yn = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT m.menu_sn , m.menu_nm , m.up_menu_sn , m.task_se_cd , m.menu_seq , d.menu_url_addr , t.menu_lv + 1 FROM kids_own.tb_pp_m_menu m LEFT JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_d_menu d ON m.menu_sn = d.menu_sn JOIN menu_tree t ON m.up_menu_sn = t.menu_sn WHERE m.task_se_cd = 'CM' AND m.menu_type_cd = 'E' AND m.use_yn = 'Y' ) SELECT menu_sn AS "menuSn" , menu_nm AS "menuNm" , up_menu_sn AS "upMenuSn" , menu_lv AS "menuLv" , task_se_cd AS "taskSeCd" , menu_seq AS "menuSeq" , menu_url_addr AS "menuUrl" FROM menu_tree ORDER BY menu_lv, menu_seq
